answer: Practically, the chain should mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because tundra only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, orchard is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any kernel approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
